title: Ideas that were not added
description: Resource pack adds items and armor that can be seen by renaming, these ideas I would like to see in minecraft but at the moment I am implementing them as a resource pack
body:
The plugin adds a ruby 3D pickaxe, copper armor, emerald armor, and an amethyst blade. The plugin requires Optifine or Cit Resewn to work. Names for renaming are listed below.

*****
- Iron Helmet-Copper Helmet
- Iron Chestplate-Copper Chestplate
- Iron Leggings-Copper Leggings
- Iron Boots-Copper Boots
*****
- Diamond Helmet-Emerald Helmet
- Diamond Chestplate-Emerald Chestplate
- Diamond Leggings-Emerald Leggings
- Diamond Boots-Emerald Boots
*****
- Diamond Pickaxe-Ruby Pickaxe
*****
- Diamond Sword-Amethyst dagger
